name: Grafana
description: Dashboards for the metrics that already live on the NAS: point Grafana at InfluxDB (or Prometheus, SQL and other sources) and build graphs, alerts and shared views in the browser. The first visit uses the built-in admin account, which you change immediately; dashboards, users and data sources live in a package volume that survives updates. The web UI opens in its own EthOS window on port 3010 and is reachable on the LAN.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.3.1: the data folder bind falls back to ./data when the compose file is rendered without EthOS (manual `docker compose down/up` in the package folder no longer fails with "empty section between colons"). 1.3.0: fixes a restart loop on the data folder — Grafana 13 runs as uid 472 and cannot write to a folder owned by EthOS, so the package now declares that uid and EthOS grants it a POSIX ACL (requires EthOS 2.35.1). 1.2.0: Grafana keeps its data in a folder on the NAS chosen at install time (default packages/data/grafana; Installed → Settings to change it) instead of a named volume, so it can live on a data disk and is visible in Files. 1.1.0: the administrator login and password can be set in the Package Center install dialog; the values reach the container as GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD and create the account on the first start. 1.0.0: first release — Grafana OSS 13.3.1 pinned, web UI on port 3010 (own login), resource caps and rotated logs.
